listing.name: Beetle Adventure Racing! / Beetle Adventure Racing! Recomp (danielgomesvieira2000)
listing.summary: Native Beetle Adventure Racing! for Windows, using your own USA cartridge dump on first Play.

steps.title: Load your original game on first Play
steps.instruction: Choose Play, then Load ROM in the player and select your own USA Beetle Adventure Racing cartridge dump. The player checks its expected game identity and keeps its own copy of the selected game in its profile, so keep your original separately. The released player needs no decompilation build or separate game-generation step.

steps.title: Keep a complete Windows player
steps.instruction: For a copy you manage yourself, extract the whole Windows x64 alpha ZIP and keep beetle-adventure-racing-recomp.exe with its assets and DLLs; debug-symbols ZIPs are not player packages. To add that copy to Portcove, select the player and its folder.

warnings: This alpha has upstream limitations; a published Windows package does not establish native/gameplay or Linux qualification.

portable.txt or an unavailable profile directory can move writes beside the executable. Preserve the location actually used and keep the current copy until ready. These external files are outside Portcove backup, runtime rollback and deletion.

references.title: Preserve the current copy and Controller Pak data
references.instruction: You or upstream provide updates. Back up the whole working folder and normally %LOCALAPPDATA%\beetle-adventure-racing-recomp, including cached ROM, Controller Pak saves, settings and bindings. portable.txt or an unavailable profile directory can move writes beside the executable. Preserve the location actually used and keep the current copy until ready. These external files are outside Portcove backup, runtime rollback and deletion.

presentation.manual_preparation: On first Play, choose Load ROM and select your own USA Beetle Adventure Racing cartridge dump. The player checks it and keeps a copy in its profile at %LOCALAPPDATA%\beetle-adventure-racing-recomp, together with Controller Pak saves, settings, bindings and cheats; keep your original separately. A copy you manage yourself without portable.txt shares that profile. Portcove refuses to start a managed copy that contains portable.txt. Portcove neither backs up nor removes the profile, and rollback does not rewind it; back it up before changing versions. Portcove replaces the player; you own the original and the profile.
